steps.name: require-full-dataset-pass-and-install-trainer
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = d337c1dae44404cadb7a63a87bb9caf4c35eec18; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/results/20260826-growbox-mvp-stage7a-full-dataset-audit-v4.json > /tmp/stage7a-result.json; grep -q '"status": "done"' /tmp/stage7a-result.json; grep -q 'FULL_DATASET_GATE=PASS' /tmp/stage7a-result.json; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7b/climate_training.py > tools/ml/climate_training.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7b/test_climate_training.py > tests/test_climate_training.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_training.py tests/test_climate_training.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_training.py tests/test_climate_training.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-climate-training-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_training.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py -q; .venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/climate_training.py tests/test_climate_training.py; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_training.py tests/test_climate_training.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_training.py tests/test_climate_training.py; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add climate v6 training comparison'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
